name: GitHub Actions CI
author: Widgeter
description: Latest GitHub Actions workflow runs for one repository, with pass/fail status, branch and duration, from the GitHub API.

config.label: Repository (owner/repo)
config.help: The repository whose workflow runs you want to watch, e.g. facebook/react.

config.label: GitHub personal access token
config.help: Optional for public repos (raises the rate limit from 60 to 5000 requests/hour). Required for private repos: create one at github.com/settings/tokens with the repo scope (or fine-grained: Actions read-only).
